commands.name: availability

options.name: --model
options.description: Model(s) to check. Repeatable or comma-separated.  Overrides the preset.

options.name: --preset
options.description: Preset supplying default regions and models. Defaults  to the active preset.

options.name: --region
options.description: Region(s) to check. Repeatable or comma-separated.  Overrides the preset.

options.name: --type
options.description: PTU type(s) to show: datazone, regional, or global.  Defaults to datazone.

commands.description: Show PTU availability for regions and models (data zone by default).

commands.name: endpoint

arguments.name: URL
arguments.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the availability API  endpoint.

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show the configured availability API endpoint.
Show or update the availability API endpoint.

commands.name: preset
remove
commands.description: Remove a preset (the 'default' preset is  protected).

commands.name: reset

options.name: --all
options.description: Also remove every preset other than  'default'.

commands.description: Restore the 'default' preset to factory  values and make it active.

commands.name: set

options.name: --models
options.description: Model list. Repeatable or comma-separated. When  creating a preset without models, factory defaults are used.

options.name: --regions
options.description: Region list. Repeatable or comma-separated. When  creating a preset without regions, factory defaults are used.

commands.description: Create a preset or update its regions/models.

commands.name: show

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Preset to show. Defaults to the active preset.

commands.description: Show a preset's regions and models.

commands.name: use
commands.description: Make a preset the active default.
Manage region/model presets and the active default.
